messages.author: dario@solettaliving.com
messages.content:
📊 Q1 Facebook Ads Budget Review

Team - need your input on final Q1 allocation. We have ~USD 10K left for the next 37 days.

I'm leaning toward Scenario C from the model:
• Prospecting CBO: USD 480/day (up from 350)
• Retargeting ABO: USD 200/day (up from 150)
• NEW Lookalike: USD 180/day (conservative launch)

This gets us to 3.02x blended ROAS and deploys most of the remaining budget.

@jessica - can you review the audience overlap numbers in WB-2? Want to make sure we're under 30% on all pairs.
@mike - thoughts on launching lookalike now vs. waiting until Q2? Risk is the 7-10 day learning phase eats into March.

thread_replies.author: jessica.torres@solettaliving.com
thread_replies.content:
Checked the overlap analysis sheet - all good:
• Prospecting vs Retargeting: 8%
• Prospecting vs Lookalike: 22%
• Retargeting vs Lookalike: 12%

All well under the 30% threshold. Green light from audience perspective 👍

thread_replies.author: mike.chang@solettaliving.com
thread_replies.content:
I'd say launch the lookalike now. Even with learning phase, we get ~20 days of optimized delivery in March. If we wait until Q2, we're leaving scale on the table.

One concern: our site traffic dipped 12% last week (probably post-Valentine's lull). If that continues, retargeting audience shrinks and we might not be able to sustain USD 200/day. Keep an eye on that.

Also - are we planning a creative refresh before end of Q1? Current ads have been running since Jan 10, might be getting stale.

thread_replies.author: dario@solettaliving.com
thread_replies.content:
Good point on traffic, Mike. I'll add a contingency in the notes - if retargeting audience drops below 70K, we scale back to USD 150/day and reallocate to prospecting.

Creative refresh is on the list for mid-March. Let's aim for new assets by Mar 10, launch Mar 15.

Okay, going with Scenario C. I'll update Ads Manager tomorrow (Feb 23) and launch lookalike on Monday Feb 24.

messages.author: jessica.torres@solettaliving.com
messages.content: FYI - Meta just released new Advantage+ shopping campaign features. Might be worth testing in Q2 if our lookalike performs well this quarter.

name: soletta-procurement
purpose: Coordinate supplier relationships and procurement strategy

messages.content: Hey team - just finished the unit economics analysis on the Jinlong quote. The numbers are really compelling.
Agreed. 18% cost reduction on diffusers would save us roughly $3,240 on the Q2 order alone (1,800 units × $1.80 savings). That's significant margin improvement.
Right. And over the full year, assuming we maintain similar volume, we're looking at ~$13K in savings. The quality samples Wang sent look solid too.
I know we have the deposit situation with Meihao and Yongxin, but from a pure unit economics perspective, this is a no-brainer. We'd recoup the lost deposits in less than 2 quarters.
Let me put together a formal recommendation. The math is clear - switching to Jinlong is the right move for Q2.

📊 **Q2 Supplier Switch Recommendation - Jinlong Manufacturing**

**Summary:** Team consensus to accept Jinlong quote for Q2 production.

**Cost Analysis:**
• Jinlong unit cost: $8.20/diffuser (18% below current $10.00)
• Q2 order: 1,800 units = $3,240 savings
• Annual projection: ~$13,000 savings

**Trade-offs:**
• Forfeit Meihao deposit: $5,000
• Forfeit Yongxin deposit: $3,000
• Jinlong 50% deposit required: $9,035
• Total immediate outflow: $17,035
• Payback period: <2 quarters

**Quality:** Samples approved, factory audit positive
**Lead time:** 35 days (comparable to current suppliers)
**MOQ:** 1,500 units (manageable)

**Recommendation:** Accept Jinlong quote. The unit economics justify the deposit forfeiture. Request Dario's approval to proceed.

thread_replies.content: Strong analysis Jessica. I'm on board with this. The savings trajectory makes the switch a clear winner.
One consideration - we should negotiate a volume commitment with Jinlong to lock in this pricing for at least 2 quarters. Don't want them to bump prices once we've switched.

messages.content: Thanks for the detailed analysis. Let me review the cash flow implications and get back to you by end of week. The unit economics look good but I need to check our liquidity position.
